tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind cards and lists. Never put body text straight on it in long runs; use card.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on background, card, popover and receipt-paper (12.8:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Match cards, sheets, the bottom dock and text fields.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus and the chip source popover. One step above card in dark.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Cobalt. The one main action per screen, selected states, Verified marks, moved-up arrows and focus rings. Not for decoration.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills (6.2:1 light, 6.1:1 dark). Dark mode uses dark text because the cobalt is lightened.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Selected value chips, the New tag and quiet cobalt surfaces.

tokens.name: primary-tint-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on primary-tint (8.2:1 light, 9.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and unselected chips.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Photo placeholders, skeleton blocks and track fills.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Supporting text on background and card (5.5:1+ light, 5.9:1+ dark; 4.8:1+ on secondary). Captions, meta lines, tab labels.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed wash on ghost buttons and rows.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors only: a failed scan, a blocked camera. Never for a garment difference or a synthetic fiber (5.0:1 on card light, 6.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only, so it may sit below 3:1.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Text field and outline-button borders (3.2:1+ on card and background in both themes).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset. 4.3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: verified
tokens.usage: Solid dot for Verified badges (from the tag or a certification).

tokens.name: claimed
tokens.usage: Half-filled dot for Claimed badges (seller text).

tokens.name: unknown
tokens.usage: Hollow ring for Unknown badges and the unknown fiber hatch (3:1+ on card).

tokens.name: fiber-plant
tokens.usage: Fiber bar segment: cotton, linen, hemp. Wheat. Always labeled.

tokens.name: fiber-animal
tokens.usage: Fiber bar segment: wool, silk, cashmere, alpaca. Clay. Always labeled.

tokens.name: fiber-regenerated
tokens.usage: Fiber bar segment: viscose, lyocell, modal. Lilac. Always labeled.

tokens.name: fiber-synthetic
tokens.usage: Fiber bar segment: polyester, nylon, acrylic, elastane. Slate, never red. Always labeled.

tokens.name: receipt-paper
tokens.usage: Impact receipts and the QR panel. A hair warmer than card so the receipt reads as paper.

tokens.name: receipt-ink
tokens.usage: Text and dashed rules on receipt-paper.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Full-screen cobalt stage for the bold landing (C). Slightly deeper in dark mode to cut glare.

tokens.name: stage-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and marks on stage (6.2:1 light, 8.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: camera
tokens.usage: Scanner and tag camera background. Identical in both themes.

tokens.name: camera-foreground
tokens.usage: Text, icons and the shutter ring on camera.

tokens.name: camera-muted
tokens.usage: Hints on camera ("Fit the whole outfit").

tokens.name: camera-control
tokens.usage: Round control backgrounds and the counter panel on camera.

tokens.name: camera-scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the photo outside traced garments (the lift).

tokens.name: trace-line
tokens.usage: Garment outline stroke while tracing.

tokens.name: trace-halo
tokens.usage: Dark edge under trace-line so outlines show on white clothes.

styles.name: type-display
styles.sample: The clothes you like already exist secondhand.
styles.usage: Intro headline only. One per screen.

styles.name: type-title-1
styles.usage: Garment name on the results header and the tag result.

styles.name: type-numeral
styles.usage: The one big number on a screen: fiber share, kg CO2 est.

styles.name: type-quote
styles.sample: you like boxy fits and earth tones.
styles.usage: The Learned line and the spoken transcript.

styles.name: type-wordmark
styles.usage: The name in the top bar. Plain type, no logo.

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: Point your camera at an outfit.
styles.usage: Body copy and the intro sub-line.

styles.name: type-footnote
styles.usage: Captions, helper text and badge words.

styles.name: type-data
styles.usage: Meta lines, timers and table values. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: type-label
styles.usage: Uppercase micro labels: est., New, receipt headers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, dot to word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between reason chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on tight cards; grid gap for Similar style.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on phones; default card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above a new section heading.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Intro screen breathing room; space under the last card for the dock.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Base radius the shadcn scale derives from (rounded-lg).

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: est. tags, New tags, the moved-up marker.

tokens.name: radius-image
tokens.usage: Listing photos and garment cut-outs.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Match cards, the dock and the counter panel.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tabs and badges.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards on background. Dark mode trades the shadow for a faint edge.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating controls: the bottom dock, sheets, the counter panel.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A garment cut-out while it flies into the results header.

opacity.note: The loading pulse fades content between full and dim. It never flashes.

tokens.name: opacity-pulse-low
tokens.usage: Lowest point of the loading pulse (Tailwind animate-pulse, 2s cycle).

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (rare; prefer keeping controls live).
